name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at the nearest naked busiest prices above / below the open — price only (reference)
why: Stops cluster just beyond the nearest naked busiest prices above / below the open; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.

scan.when: !rollwin && ((hi(5,1) > npoca && cl(5,1) < npoca) || (lo(5,1) < npocb && cl(5,1) > npocb))
scan.dir: (lo(5,1) < npocb && cl(5,1) > npocb) - (hi(5,1) > npoca && cl(5,1) < npoca)
